job_description:
Chief AI Scientist

Job Summary:

Capital One is searching for an accomplished Director of Generative AI with expertise in the development of AI platforms. This job requires overseeing AI engineers and applied scientists who will work on fine-tuning training pipelines, deploying large ML models, and building scalable infrastructure using modern cloud technologies. The successful candidate will have a significant role to play in Capital One's effort to revolutionize the banking industry by leveraging the transformative power of generative AI.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Direct a group of experts involved in building the groundwork for the Generative AI platform by leading AI engineers and applied scientists.
• Implementing distributed training clusters in the public cloud requires a comprehensive understanding of cloud computing concepts, including virtualization, network security, and cloud-based storage solutions.
• The establishment of a fault-tolerant infrastructure is necessary to ensure that extended training tasks can be carried out effectively and without interruptions.
• Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration with existing systems and processes.
• With the primary goal of empowering our users, we are determined to create SDKs and APIs for the user community to build anomaly/fraud detection systems and information retrieval on our Gen AI platform.

Qualifications and Experience:
• The successful candidate must hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
• I have had the privilege of working with large-scale machine learning systems for more than seven years, during which I have attained exceptional skills and experience in this domain.
• With more than six years of experience in developing AI/ML algorithms, I have built a proven track record for implementing solutions in Python and C/C++.
• A seasoned professional possessing 5 years or more of experience leading teams that include engineers and applied scientists.
• My comprehensive knowledge of the complete ML development life cycle and expertise in using open-source AI/ML frameworks and public cloud makes me an invaluable asset to any project.
• Attaining an advanced degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical area can enable you to conduct cutting-edge research and make significant contributions to the field.
• Familiar with machine learning concepts and has experience in training and deploying deep neural nets and/or transformer architectures in high volume.
• Scrutinize research publications featured in well-established peer-reviewed conferences or industry-recognized open-source contributions.
• Proficient in working with popular machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Lightning, and Mosaic ML on GPU clusters. Extensive knowledge of various GPU hardware setups and their impact on machine learning performance.
• The capability to pivot quickly and iterate effectively in a volatile, fast-paced environment.
• Proficient in handling and managing public cloud infrastructures like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Capability to effectively deploy and manage extensive neural network models to meet the challenges of rigorous production settings.

Benefits of the Position:
• A system of incentive compensation based on performance, encompassing financial bonuses and continuing rewards.
• The company provides a complete range of benefits that are aimed at promoting overall well-being, including financial and health-related assistance.
• Perhaps one of the most exciting aspects of working at Capital One is the potential for unlimited growth and opportunity for those who work hard and demonstrate their potential.
• A welcoming and supportive workplace that understands the importance of personal and professional growth for every individual.

About Company:

Capital One's investment in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms uniquely positions us to create innovative and scalable generative AI systems. With a focus on reliability and trust, we aim to develop automated, real-time customer experiences that are unmatched in the industry.

job_description:
When you join Verizon

Verizon is one of the world's leading providers of technology and communications services, transforming the way we connect around the world. We're a human network that reaches across the globe and works behind the scenes. We anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together-lifting up our communities and striving to make an impact to move the world forward. If you're fueled by purpose, and powered by persistence, explore a career with us. Here, you'll discover the rigor it takes to make a difference and the fulfillment that comes with living the #NetworkLife.

What we're looking for:

As a Senior AI Product Manager for the Verizon Consumer Group AI platforms team, you will be responsible for ideating, strategizing, building and driving AI product capabilities to optimize frontline productivity and deliver AI recommended solutions. The CXO organization is focused on strengthening VCG's position in its current market and also shaping the Employee Experience Products, Platforms and Tools to leverage VCG's AI capabilities for optimized frontline staffing, planning & operations.

The CXO AI platforms team is a strategic AI Ops team aimed at building a suite of AI/ML products in many employee-facing use cases, from desktop experiences to scheduling/forecasting. The AI programs are executed in partnership with the business and Enterprise AI & Data teams. You will be the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) and accountable for developing new ideas & prototypes in partnership with AI & Data Teams, bridging the gap between the business needs and the suite of AI capabilities being developed within Verizon. Quickly developing solutions and building the case for change to clearly articulate business value & gain support from stakeholders. Building roadmaps, assessing feasibility, for product development. This role will continuously evaluate and plan a path for attainment of AI business objectives, leveraging AI insights, KPI trends and analytics, and enabling AI-recommended business decisions for partner teams.

Responsibilities:
• Developing and executing a strategy and roadmap for products based on analytics and AI/ML that drive business outcomes, while considering user feedback, competitive analysis, and business goals.
• Responsible for management and/or development of a product or products, including development of business requirements, planning, business justification, verification, forecasting, pricing, profitability, and launch at all stages of the product life cycle; involved in bringing products to market and longer-term evolution and maintenance of product suites.
• Identifying AI opportunities across VCG and apply existing AI solutions in new ways to drive value at-scale.
• Actively collaborating with change agents in the business and with business transformation managers to define & implement change elements to support the AI solution.
• Proactively identifying and addressing technical strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats across the AI/ML landscape, embrace change and adapt to new and emerging AI industry trends
• Leveraging explainable AI for transparent, responsible AI standards and recommendations to business partners and drive alignment.
• Partnering with business and technology stakeholders in the identification of business requirements, functional design, process design, prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures.
• Leading multiple cross-functional teams charged with improving the customer and employee experiences and implementing strategic enterprise-wide efficiency-driving programs.
• Preparing and executing regular program updates to senior management with weekly status reports
• Ensuring adoption of solutions and processes so that improvements are realized and benefits are attained
• Partnering with Business, Strategy, Operations, AI & Data Analytics organizations to identify and implement AI products, use cases and storytelling with insights for workforce planning solutions
• Monitoring and evaluating the effectiveness of AI initiatives through success metrics, A/B Testing, AI model efficacy and What If scenario planning capabilities
• Reviewing and analyzing current AI modeling results, refine product features, review model outputs and analyze trends to provide business recommendations.
• Leading agile ACT team as an AI Product Owner for sprint planning, sprint execution, sprint releases, UAT testing, evangelize AI and drive business adoption at various levels.

What we're looking for:

You have an imaginative product mindset and extensive experience with delivering AI/ML driven solutions. You are comfortable working in an innovation-focused environment - in particular, evaluating emerging trends and technologies to assess their feasibility, viability and functioning effectively in a fail-fast environment. You are a self-starter and a quick learner, and are able to innovate and report on tasks and status proactively.

You'll need to have:
• Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
• Six or more years of relevant work experience.
• Experience in quickly prototyping new solutions using AI/ML models
• Experience partnering with AI/ML engineers, data scientists, BI teams on analytics projects.
• Experience with product/project management skills and roles.
• Experience in designing, developing and deploying AI/ ML projects.
• Experience in forecasting models, supply/demand & schedule optimization AI/ML models.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:
• MBA/Master's degree in computer science, data science or an AI-related discipline.
• Black or Green Belt in Lean | Six-Sigma.
• Five or more years of experience in Telecom, customer service, retail sales, supply chain and/or Marketing.
• Prior knowledge of Retail POS or Customer Service platforms such as ACSS or Live Chat or Inside Sales
• Strong Agile, Scrum and Product leadership abilities leading cross-functional teams
• Proficiency in engaging and influencing large teams and functional leaders at various levels.
• Excellent analytical, project management, problem-solving and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently, efficiently and effectively under time constraints and deliver results by critical deadlines.
• Strong competency in Telecom systems, practices and sales and support channels.
• Experience in dynamic forecasting, supply/demand & schedule optimization AI/ML models
• Functional knowledge of SQL, Data Visualization tools Tableau, Qlik, Looker on Google Cloud/Teradata
• Management Consulting experience working on transformational AI initiatives.
• Understanding of AI-related coding languages is a plus but not required
• The ideal candidate will possess an AI background and a comprehensive domain knowledge of Retail Store operations or Call center operations, workforce planning and forecasting processes.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every "even better" qualification listed above.

Where you'll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

Scheduled Weekly Hours
40

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our employees' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status. At Verizon, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected, and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best. Check out our diversity and inclusion page to learn more.

job_description:
West Creek 4 (12074), United States of America, Richmond, VirginiaSenior Manager, Generative AI Risk Management (ES Risk)

Do you want to join a highly collaborative team that’s dedicated to making risk management a competitive advantage at Capital One? We are looking to hire a new Senior Manager, with emphasis on Generative AI, that will bring unique perspectives and experiences to drive our Material Tech and Cyber Change (MTC) and Targeted Risk Assessment (TRA) programs forward within the Enterprise Services (ES) Risk Office.

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has led the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of generative AI to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build by providing structure and governance to our Generative AI Risk efforts.

The successful candidate will be an experienced cybersecurity and risk professional who understands technology functions and organizations, with strong analytical, planning, strategic thinking, organizational and communication skills. You will work with smart and passionate people to deliver results that have a direct impact on the future of Capital One. This is an important and exciting responsibility from day one, working with key engineering, product and risk stakeholders across the company.

Responsibilities:
• Guide our MTC / TRA team in the development and execution of our ES Risk vision, and deliver on enterprise and team objectives with a focus on Generative AI and related cloud services.
• Partner with the first-line of defense Technology and Cyber teams, Lines of Business, and second-line of defense risk management teams, to ensure effective collaboration within the team and across stakeholder groups.
• Contribute to the creation and refinement of well managed practices for identifying, managing, tracking, and mitigating risks related to Generative AI and related cloud services.
• Develop and help deliver senior level risk management reporting and communications, including for material initiatives, overall program direction, and results towards strategic objectives.
• Continuously look for ways to improve and innovate our approach to risk management.
• Stay current on the changing regulatory environment and understand the impacts to our efforts.
• Write and revise documents such as policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines. Develop and enhance processes, tools, templates, and job aides. Draft, edit, and deliver presentations that aid in the design, development, refinement, and usage of risk methods.
• Support interactions with Internal Audit and Regulatory agencies related to our work, as applicable.

Here's what we're looking for in an ideal teammate:
• You are a critical thinker who seeks to understand the business and its control environment.
• You possess a relentless focus on quality and timeliness.
• You adapt to change, embrace bold ideas, and are intellectually curious. You like to ask questions, test assumptions, and challenge conventional thinking.
• You develop influential relationships based upon shared risk objectives and trust to deliver outstanding business impact.
• You are an experienced risk management professional who understands technology functions and organizations.
• You have the ability to communicate clearly and to interact effectively at all levels of the organization, and to influence as warranted and appropriate to drive consensus
• You have the ability to manage multiple high-visibility and high-impact projects while maintaining superior results
• You have the experience with security best practices for generative AI development and deployments
• You effectively work in white space and bring structure to deliver on our well managed agenda
• You are effective at articulating complex technical concepts in a clear, concise, and actionable manner through both written and verbal communication.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or military experience
• At least 5 years of experience in Process, Project, Risk Management, or Cloud Risk Management
• At least 5 years of experience planning and leading IT audits and risk assessments, or a combination
• At least 3 years direct experience with AI and ML model lifecycle management, operations or deployments
• At least 2 years of experience developing presentations for executive level audiences

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master’s Degree in Computer Science or in an Engineering discipline
• 7+ years of experience in Process, Project, Product, Risk Management, or Cloud Risk Management
• 4+ years of experience with AI and ML specific model lifecycle management including understanding of AI and ML architecture, model risk, data management and Responsible AI practices
• 1+ years of experience drafting and communicating reports or analytic assessments for executives
• 1+ years of experience with identifying and communicating key risks to AI implementations and architectures
• 1+ years of experience with risk analysis and reports that describe risk implications to executives
• 1+ years of experience with AI and ML frameworks (NIST AI)
• 1+ years of experience working in financial services or other highly regulated sectors

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

New York City (Hybrid On-Site): $199,100 - $227,200 for Sr. Manager, Cyber Risk & Analysis

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website . Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender reassignment, citizenship, immigration status, protected veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under applicable federal, state or local law. job_title: Senior Director, Cloud Operation + Innovation AI Delivery Program Controls
job_description:
Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the team behind one of the world’s largest Cloud Infrastructures, responsible for powering all Microsoft online Products and Services as well as powering Microsoft’s “Cloud First” mission. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide, and we are looking for a passionate, high-energy detail-oriented Senior Director CO+I AI Delivery Program Controls to help achieve that mission.

If you want to have a fundamental impact on how Microsoft’s Cloud is deployed to support AI and you want to be involved with one of the most strategically important teams at Microsoft, this job might be perfect for you. If you are constantly curious, have excellent technical and business acumen, lead from the front and embrace out of the box thinking, this Senior Director CO+I AI Delivery Program Controls could be an opportunity to explore.

You should be an experienced technical program manager with deep technical and business expertise, extraordinary leadership and demonstrated large-scale technical program management success. You should have exceptional industry knowledge, technical depth in delivery execution, and have the executive presence to lead complex and time sensitive initiatives.

The CO+I AI Delivery team is a newly formed group focused on delivering various platform services to our global AI customers. This role will require deep partnership throughout all of Microsoft as these programs will be on the leading edge of innovation and will include driving pilots and other experiments that shape our ongoing commitment to deliver AI platform services on schedule. In this role you will lead a team that will be required to establish clear metrics, develop technical engineering requirements for process automation, drive down variation across key deployment milestones, drive accountability across partner organizations, remove roadblocks to keep programs on schedule, organize, track and deliver the hundreds of specific projects that make up an AI platform delivery service. In this role you will be directly accountable for specific AI delivery schedules from signal, through construction, all the way to service live and leverage resources throughout the company to deliver to the expectations of the customer.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Required/Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
• OR equivalent experience.
• 6+ years experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
• 8+ years of experience delivering multi-year technology projects at scale.
• 5+ years of experience in engineering disciplines centered on cloud technologies.
• 5+ years of experience in data center or network operations

Other Requirements:
• Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
• OR equivalent experience.
• 10+ years experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
• MBA with a technology undergraduate degree.
• Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills.
• Ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex challenges, and operate in a fast-paced team environment.
• Combination of server, network, and datacenter operations background.
• Construction program management across a complex datacenter landscape.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence senior level cross functional teams
• Professional PM certification, CNAA, ACMA, VCTA-NV, JNCIA
• or equivalent
• Experience setting up, building and maintaining global production schedules
• Experience starting large analytic projects and collaborating with teams across global functions
• Experience solving complex architectural problems and influencing designs at the source.
• Experience in building teams to deploy new technologies at scale.

job_title: Applied Scientist II, Ring & Blink AI
job_description:
Description

Are you fueled by a passion for computer vision, machine learning and AI, and are eager to leverage your skills to enrich the lives of millions across the globe? Join us at Ring AI team, where we're not just offering a job, but an opportunity to revolutionize safety and convenience in our neighborhoods through cutting-edge innovation.

You will be part of a dynamic team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of computer vision, machine learning and AI to deliver an unparalleled user experience for our neighbors. This position presents an exceptional opportunity for you to pioneer and innovate in AI, making a profound impact on millions of customers worldwide. You will partner with world-class AI scientists, engineers, product managers and other experts to develop industry-leading AI algorithms and systems for a diverse array of Ring and Blink products, enhancing the lives of millions of customers globally. Join us in shaping the future of AI innovation at Ring and Blink, where exciting challenges await!

Key job responsibilities
• Research and implement the state-of-the-art computer vision and machine learning methods to deliver high-quality artifacts that meets product specifications.
• Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large-scale data analysis, machine-learning model development, model validation and gap analysis.
• Research new machine learning approaches to drive continued scientific innovation.
• Work in a collaborative environment with other scientists, engineers, product managers and cross-functional teams.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:

Bellevue, WA, USA | Sunnyvale, CA, USA

Basic Qualifications
• 3+ years of building models for business application experience
• PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
• Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
• Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred Qualifications
• Proven track record of innovation in creating novel algorithms and advancing the state-of-the-art
• Experience in prototyping, designing, implementing and deploying large-scale computer vision and AI applications
• Experience in developing highly-optimized CV and ML algorithms on resource-constrained platforms
• Exceptional writing and verbal communications skills
